name: tests-50pct-ferret-conversion-work-budgets
instr:
Add shared conversion budgets. Preserve existing behavior.

These are required in what you deliver from `github.com/MontFerret/ferret/v2/pkg/runtime`:

- `ConversionLimit`: ConversionLimitSteps, ConversionLimitDepth, ConversionLimitTextBytes.
- `ConversionLimits{MaxSteps, MaxDepth, MaxTextBytes}`; `ConversionUsage{Steps, Depth, TextBytes}`.
- `ConversionLimitError{Limit, Target, Used, Maximum}` implementing error; `IsConversionLimit(error)`.
- `NewConversionBudget(limits ConversionLimits) (*ConversionBudget, error)`; `(*ConversionBudget).Snapshot() ConversionUsage`.
- `WithConversionBudget(ctx context.Context, budget *ConversionBudget) context.Context`; `ConversionBudgetFromContext(ctx context.Context) (*ConversionBudget, bool)`.
- `engine.WithConversionLimits` from `github.com/MontFerret/ferret/v2/pkg/engine` and `ferret.WithConversionLimits` from the root package.

Budgets start unused; attaching one retains its identity, and absent context returns nil/false. Zero limits allow conversion. Reject negative runtime/engine MaxSteps, engine MaxDepth, and root MaxTextBytes.

Share committed text usage across Int then Float conversions, including compatibility-wrapped values and standard-library adapters. Reject text exceeding the remaining allowance without charging rejected text. Concurrent native/wrapped numeric conversions stay within step/text limits and record positive usage.

Int and Float diagnose text exhaustion with their respective targets, retain strconv.NumError for m
